name: fmp_price_target
description:
Individual analyst price targets for one stock from Financial Modeling Prep (FMP, /stable/price-target): target price, analyst, firm, publication date and price when posted.
Returns {symbol, targets}: FMP's list of target records.
Inputs (* required): symbol* (ticker, e.g. AAPL; upper-cased), limit (integer, number of records; default 5).
For the consensus (average/high/low) use fmp_price_target_summary; per-analyst view: fmp_price_target_by_analyst; rating changes: fmp_upgrades_downgrades.
Needs an FMP API key (config fmp.api.key, env FMP_API_KEY); without one it returns a demo placeholder naming the endpoint instead of data.
Example: {"symbol": "AAPL", "limit": 5}
